title: Global Optimality for Constrained Exploration via Penalty Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2604.28144v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Efficient exploration is a central problem in reinforcement learning and is often formalized as maximizing the entropy of the state-action occupancy measure. While unconstrained maximum-entropy exploration is relatively well understood, real-world exploration is often constrained by safety, resource, or imitation requirements. This constrained setting is particularly challenging because entropy maximization lacks additive structure, rendering Bellman-equation-based methods inapplicable. Moreover, scalable approaches require policy parameterization, inducing non-convexity in both the objective and the constraints. To our knowledge, the only prior model-free policy-gradient approach for this setting under general policy parameterization is due to Ying et al. (2025). Unfortunately, their guarantees are limited to weak regret and ergodic averages, which do not imply that the final output is a single deployable policy that is near-optimal

translated_title: 基于惩罚正则化的约束探索全局最优性
translated_abstract: 高效探索是强化学习中的一个核心问题，通常被形式化为最大化状态-动作占用测度的熵。尽管无约束的最大熵探索已相对被充分理解，但现实世界中的探索往往受到安全性、资源或模仿需求的约束。这种约束设置尤其具有挑战性，因为熵最大化缺乏可加结构，使得基于贝尔曼方程的方法不再适用。此外，可扩展的方法需要策略参数化，这在目标和约束中都引入了非凸性。据我们所知，此前针对该设置在一般策略参数化下唯一的无模型策略梯度方法来自 Ying 等人（2025）。然而遗憾的是，他们的理论保证仅限于弱遗憾和遍历平均，这并不能保证最终输出是一个接近最优的单一可部署策略。
tldr: 该论文提出基于惩罚正则化的策略梯度方法，在一般策略参数化下首次为约束最大熵探索实现了全局最优性保证，从而能够输出单一可部署的近最优策略。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a penalty-regularized policy-gradient approach that achieves global optimality guarantees for constrained maximum-entropy exploration under general policy parameterization, yielding a single deployable near-optimal policy.
